90: ### The fill line format (frozen)
91: 
92: One physical line, placed immediately below the section heading.
93: 
94: ```text
95: <!-- FILL: <instruction> GOOD: <good example> WEAK: <weak example> -->
96: ```
97: 
98: When the table below has `-` in both the Good and the Weak cell, the line is:
99: 
100: ```text
101: <!-- FILL: <instruction> -->
102: ```
103: 
104: Rules for the text inside the line:
105: - The instruction is one imperative sentence and ends with a period.
106: - No cell contains `[YOUR_VALUE_HERE:`, `[NEEDS_CLARIFICATION:`, `-->`, `;` or an em dash. A short priority mark such as `[P0]` is allowed because it is not a token.
107: - The line is never wrapped. It is one line in the template source.
108: - The good example is concrete and short. The weak example is the failure a weak model produces: vague, generic or a restatement of the heading.
109: - The model deletes the line when it fills the section. A line left behind is not a placeholder, so it never fails the gate.

818: ### ADR-001: Put the guidance in an HTML comment below the heading
819: 
820: **Status**: Accepted

857: **Decision**: `check-example-drift.sh` calls `node runtime/cli/utils/template-structure.js compare <level> <doc> <example> anchors` and fails on any `missing_anchor` or `extra_anchor` line.

867:

869:

871: 
872: **Decision**: An example must carry every required anchor and no anchor outside the template's allowed set. Optional anchors may be absent.

875: - The alignment table is 14 files, not 24.
876: - A missing optional section is not drift.

879: - Full set equality: it would force `affected-surfaces` and the L3+ workstream sections into every example.

882: 
883: **Status**: Accepted
884:

886: 
887: **Decision**: Lanes A and B finish first. The conductor runs `npx vitest run runtime/cli/tests/scaffold-golden-snapshots.vitest.ts -u` once, then reruns without `-u`.
